contentPattern: Row 1: background image (pattern or photo). Row 2: H1 (page title), optional paragraph subtitle. Either row may be omitted: image-only renders the banner without text, heading-only renders the H1 on the brand sky-blue fallback background.
reuseGuidance: Use as the first block of content pages for the full-width title banner (patterned or photo background with centered white H1). Not for promotional heroes with CTAs.
